name: Reel
text: Merge the transcript fetch for *"The Science of Sleep Optimization"* into the existing AI Executive Assistant workflow. The Creative team already has the pattern for orchestrating Luma agents; adding this transcript as a single input streamlines production without new tooling. Trade-off: we accept a short delay to validate the transcript’s quality before feeding it into the pipeline.

name: Scriv
text: The transcript merge risks locking us into a single input format forever. Instead, standardize a minimal metadata layer—title, speaker, timestamp—for every creative asset before it hits the workflow. Creative owns the spec; Engineering enforces it at ingest. Done when the spec doc exists and the first asset ships with it.
